title: Investcorp acquires significant minority through Its Saudi Pre-IPO growth fund alongside AlTouq Group consortium to acquire REDA Gulf Holding
summary: The investment underscores Investcorp's continued momentum in Saudi Arabia and commitment to supporting leading regional businesses through their next phase of growth
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
Kingdom of Saudi Arabia – Investcorp, a leading global alternative investment firm, through its Saudi Pre-IPO Growth Fund, joins a consortium led by AlTouq Group and Thara Future Investments in the acquisition of REDA Gulf Holding ("RGH" or the “Company”), the holding company of REDA Hazard Control.  

The transaction represents the latest investment by Investcorp's Saudi Pre-IPO Growth Fund and reflects the consortium’s continued confidence in the long-term growth prospects of Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. It also reflects Investcorp’s strong investment pipeline, partnering with reputable consortium members and continued focus on developing high-quality businesses in sectors critical to the region’s economic growth and transformation. 

Founded in Saudi Arabia in 1986, REDA Gulf Holding has established itself as a market leader in fire protection, safety and security solutions, serving a diversified base of blue-chip customers across multiple sectors, including highly demanding industrial environments. The Company provides end-to-end solutions spanning product supply and distribution, local assembly and manufacturing, systems installation and ongoing maintenance services. RGH employs more than 1,700 skilled engineers and technicians and today operates across 19 countries.  

The consortium intends to build on RGH’s capabilities, its alignment with Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 and its role in serving critical and emerging sectors, to support the Company’s next phase of growth. 

AbdulMohsen AlTouq, Chairman of REDA Gulf Holding said: “The Company has built an exceptional reputation over nearly four decades as a trusted leader in fire, safety, security and hazard-control solutions. We are impressed by REDA Gulf Holding’s strong market position, talented workforce, deep customer relationships and proven management team. This investment aligns with our strategy of partnering with high-quality businesses. We are pleased to have brought together a strong consortium and look forward to working alongside our exceptional partners and the management team to accelerate the Company’s next phase of growth.” 

Walid Majdalani, Head of Investcorp Private Equity Emerging Markets at Investcorp, said: "We are delighted to be part of this consortium and to support a Company that has consistently demonstrated operational excellence and a strong commitment to its customers and suppliers. This investment reflects the strategy of our Saudi Pre-IPO Growth Fund: identifying leading businesses with strong fundamentals and partnering with management teams and like-minded prominent shareholders to accelerate growth and strengthen institutional capabilities. Together with our partners, we look forward to supporting REDA Gulf Holding as it builds on its strong market position and captures the opportunities ahead.” 

Mohamad Ezzat Beck, Chief Executive Officer of REDA Gulf Holding, said: “This investment is a strong recognition of what our team has built over the years and reflects the confidence of our new shareholders in REDA Gulf Holding, its people, and its future. It also reinforces our shared commitment to Saudi Arabia and the significant opportunities ahead. With the support of our new shareholders, we will continue strengthening our leadership in fire protection, safety, and security solutions, expanding our local manufacturing and engineering capabilities, and pursuing new opportunities across the Kingdom and international markets. As we enter this exciting new chapter, our priorities remain unchanged: delivering excellence to our customers, maintaining the highest safety standards, investing in our people, and contributing to Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030.” 

Hisham Attar, Founder and Managing Partner of Thara Future Investments, commented: “We are delighted to join this consortium alongside our partners. REDA Gulf Holding’s leadership in fire, safety and hazard-control solutions makes it a critical enabler of the Kingdom’s industrial growth. Thara brings patient capital, sector expertise and a strong local network, and we look forward to working with the management team to deepen localization, expand into new markets and build a Saudi national champion.” 

The transaction represents the fifth investment made by Investcorp Saudi Pre-IPO Growth Fund LP. Through the Fund, Investcorp continues to partner with founders, management teams and reputed shareholders to support businesses as they scale, institutionalize and realize their long-term growth ambitions. Prior to its investment in REDA Gulf Holding, the Fund invested in Metra, NourNet, TruKKer, and Salla. 

About Investcorp

Investcorp is a global investment manager specializing in alternative investments across four asset classes: Private Equity (Mid-Market Buyouts, Growth Investments, and GP Staking), Real Assets (Real Estate and Infrastructure), Credit (CLOs, Broadly Syndicated Loans & Structured Credit, and Middle-Market Direct Lending), and Liquid Strategies (Absolute Return Investments and Insurance Asset Management). 

Since our inception in 1982, we have focused on generating attractive returns for our clients and seeking to create long-term value in our portfolio companies by adopting a disciplined investment process, employing talented professionals, and utilizing the resources of a global institution with an innovative approach. 

We invest capital in our products and strategies, aligning interests with our clients and other stakeholders. We pursue sustainable value creation through our investments and in the communities in which we operate and take pride in partnering with clients to deliver tailored solutions for their needs. 

Today, Investcorp manages approximately $64 billion in assets, including assets managed by third-party managers. Investcorp has 14 offices in the US, Europe, GCC and Asia, including, India, China, Japan and Singapore and employs approximately 500 people from 50 nationalities globally. 

For further information, visit www.investcorp.com and follow us @Investcorp on LinkedIn , X and Instagram . 

About AlTouq Group

AlTouq Group is a Saudi Arabian family office headquartered in Riyadh. It has grown into an institutional investor with a diversified portfolio across local and international markets.

AlTouq Group follows a thematic investment approach, deploying patient, long-term capital into high-conviction opportunities centered on Saudi Arabia. Its sectors of focus are financial services, consumer-driven sectors, mining services, energy, and technology and innovation. The Group draws on a generational understanding of the Saudi market and an extensive international network, and its long-term strategies are aligned with the Kingdom’s economic diversification and the development of sectors critical to national competitiveness. 

For further information, visit www.altouq.com . 

About Thara Investments 

Thara Investments is a specialised Saudi investment platform that puts capital into strategic sectors offering attractive risk-adjusted returns. It was co-founded by Hisham Attar, formerly a Senior Director at PIF, and is backed by Altouq and other prominent Saudi business leaders and family groups. Its aim is to build national champions that support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030. 

About REDA Gulf Holding 

REDA Gulf Holding is a leading provider of fire protection, safety, security, and hazard-control solutions headquartered in Saudi Arabia. Established in 1986, the Company delivers comprehensive end-to-end solutions spanning product supply and distribution, engineering and systems integration, local assembly and manufacturing, systems installation, and maintenance services. 

The Company operates four manufacturing plants in Saudi Arabia, with a combined footprint exceeding 500,000 square feet, reinforcing its commitment to local manufacturing and industrial development. RGH also undertakes large-scale, complex turnkey projects for major industrial, energy, and infrastructure clients.

With more than 1,700 skilled engineers and technicians and operations across 19 countries, RGH serves a diversified portfolio of blue-chip customers across the industrial, infrastructure, commercial, and energy sectors in Saudi Arabia and international markets.
